title: Pegasus FS700P
subtitle: 4-Needle Feed-Off-Arm Interlock Stitch Machine for Flat Seaming (FS700 series)

purposeAndApplication.purpose: The Pegasus FS700P is a 4-needle, feed-off-arm, cylinder-bed interlock stitch machine built for flat seaming. The Pegasus FS700P series covers a range of subclasses tailored for T-shirts, sports tights, swimsuits, briefs, and other flat-seam operations. Comes with right and left independent differential feed adjustment, oil-barrier type construction, and optional single or double edge trimming.
applications: T-shirt shoulder and side seaming (flat seaming, single or double edge trimming)
Any operation requiring flat, low-bulk seams on knit fabrics
purposeAndApplication.industry: Knit garment manufacturing, T-shirt production, sportswear, underwear, swimwear, intimate apparel

overviewDescription: Made by Pegasus Sewing Machine Mfg. Co., Ltd. (Japan; with extensive China manufacturing/distribution). The FS700 series is Pegasus's flat-stitch lineup, sitting alongside the M700 overlock series. The official Pegasus catalog distinguishes several subclasses within the FS700P series (FS701P, FS703P, etc.) tailored to specific applications. All share the 4-needle feed-off-arm interlock architecture with cylinder bed and independent differential-feed adjustment.

finalNotes:
• Phase 1 PASS — Pegasus Tier-1 manufacturer pages confirmed the FS700P series as the real full-model number behind the bare 'FS700' identifier. The PFS700P-A subclasses (T-shirt / sports / swimsuits / briefs) cover a range of flat-seaming applications. Pegasus Europa instruction manual PDF available for daily-routine maintenance and safety.
• Pegasus America spec lists 4,200 sti/min; Pegasus Japan lists 3,800 sti/min. The higher Aajjo value (5,000 sti/min) likely reflects Indian-market Chinese-OEM spec. Headline resolved to 3,800 sti/min (Tier-1 manufacturer).
